thread.title: Monday's ETF with Unusual Volume: EDOW

author: BNK Invest
title: Monday's ETF with Unusual Volume: EDOW
text:
Shutterstock photo The First Trust Dow 30 Equal Weight ETF ( EDOW ) is seeing unusually high volume in afternoon trading Monday, with over 923,000 shares traded versus three month average volume of about 44,000. Shares of EDOW were down about 1.1% on the day.
Components of that ETF with the highest volume on Monday were Apple ( AAPL ), trading off about 0.2% with over 39.7 million shares changing hands so far this session, and Microsoft ( MSFT ), up about 1.1% on volume of over 19.6 million shares. Intel ( INTC ) is the component faring the best Monday, higher by about 1.3% on the day, while Exxon Mobil ( XOM ) is lagging other components of the First Trust Dow 30 Equal Weight ETF, trading lower by about 2.6%.
